disableDataRequestOnFirstRender.description: Disable if you want to avoid sending any and all requests for this component on first render.

wrapWithMetadataId.description: Whether to wrap the component with a div which has a class name of its metdata id. Useful for targeting with css.

title:
A base type for all UI components.

The metadata content files for this type have to be placed under the `/ui/c3/meta/` folder. You can have any
folder structure to group your components however you like but they have to be inside that parent folder for
them to be usable by the C3 UI Framework.
